text_block_list.text:
(Was it because I was eating sweets
while reading...?
Maybe I overindulged a little...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Focusing too hard and letting your attention wander just won't do, will it... *sigh*...

Zenno Rob Roy seems to be worried
about her skin breaking out...
